literal_meaning: খবিশ (আরবি 'খবীث' থেকে উদ্ভূত, অশুদ্ধ বা দুষ্ট আত্মা)
figurative_meaning_en: According to Muslim beliefs, an evil spirit or ghost
example_sentences_in_bangla: গ্রামে সেই বাড়িতে খবিশের ভয়ে কেউ যায় না।
example_sentences_in_english: No one goes to that house in the village for fear of khobish.
An ojha was called to exorcise the khobish.
history: Referenced in the 18th-century Bengali poet Bharat Chandra Ray Gunakar's work: 'খবিশ পাইল বলি ডাকি আনি ওঝা', highlighting traditional exorcism practices.
note: The term draws from Islamic concepts of jinn or impure spirits prevalent in Bengali Muslim culture.
